design_philosophy: A fusion of 1911 historic Portuguese heritage with modern community utility. We use the official deep green (#0d6b4f) anchored by warm bone-white backgrounds. Photography takes center stage with cinematic, textural elements, emphasizing 'E1' principles: Contrast (Classic Serif vs Modern Sans), Negative Space, and Zoom In (details of history and community).

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24 for section padding. Generous negative space.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento grids for Services section (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, gap-8). Asymmetrical layouts for History page.
layout_and_spacing.corners: rounded-sm (2px) to rounded-none. Avoid heavy rounding to maintain a classic, grounded feel.

surfaces_and_effects.cards: Flat surfaces with 1px delicate borders (border-border). No heavy drop shadows. Tactile and sharp.
surfaces_and_effects.hero_overlay: bg-black/40 mixed with a very subtle green tint to ensure text readability.

hero_banner.description: Historic stone building with classical details for the homepage hero background.

history_1911.description: Vintage wax seal to represent the 1911 foundation on the History section.

theater_service.description: Illuminated stage in an empty classic theater for the Theater Group service.

sports_service.description: Empty indoor sports arena for the Sports service.

hall_rental.description: Wood-paneled room with chairs for Hall Rental service.

components.navigation: Sticky, Glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border). Contains Logo (Cormorant Garamond), Main Links, and 'Join Now' CTA.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary_hover rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-medium tracking-wide. Secondary: border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/5.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components but strip standard Vercel look. Use square corners, bg-white inputs with border-border, focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary.
components.events_calendar: Minimalist grid. Highlight dates with green accents. Use clear typography and ample padding.
components.admin_dashboard: Clean, high-contrast utility layout (Archetype 4 variant). White background, 1px borders, dense data presentation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette, using the official green (#0d6b4f) primarily for accents, buttons, and section backgrounds.
Ensure headings use Cormorant Garamond with tight tracking, and body text uses Outfit.
Incorporate the provided image URLs exactly as mapped. Do not use generic placeholders.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) as per testing rules.
For the hero banner, apply the bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast over the historic building image.
Construct the Services section using a 'Bento' or asymmetrical grid, featuring the Theater, Sports, and Hall Rental images.
